Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. The Infrastructure Security team’s mission is to build a secure-by-default foundation across Notion’s technical stacks—architecting systems that make the secure path the easy path. As an IC4 on this team, you’ll own meaningful infrastructure security problems end-to-end: from identifying risk, to designing pragmatic controls, to shipping secure defaults that scale across engineering. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. review_candidates.description: AGOL Worldwide is a Miami based freight forwarder built for shipments that cannot fail. We specialize in time critical logistics (expedited air, next flight out, and hand carry) and global trade services as Importer and Exporter of Record. We hold IATA, CTPAT, NVOCC, and TSA Indirect Air Carrier credentials, and our team works across the US, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Pakistan, and India. We are hiring a Senior Manager, Human Resources to lead our people function in every country where AGOL has employees and contractors. You will report directly to the CEO, lead an HR team of one, and build the processes that make AGOL a well run, compliant, and fair place to work. This is a builder role for someone who wants to own HR end to end at a growing international company. What you will own HR operations: day to day HR matters for all employees and contractors, onboarding through the first 90 days, offboarding, and an accurate employee database. Recruitment and hiring: write job descriptions with hiring managers, post roles, screen candidates, coordinate interviews, manage offers, and run background and reference checks before offers are finalized. Performance management: design and run the appraisal process, link results to increments and raises, manage performance improvement plans, and coach managers on giving feedback. Employee relations: handle issues, grievances, and investigations fairly and confidentially, and advise managers on discipline and conflict resolution. Policies and compliance: document HR SOPs and policies, maintain the employee handbook and holiday calendar, manage contractor agreements, and keep contracts and practices compliant with labor law in each country. Leave management: select and implement a leave management solution and manage leave across all countries. Compensation and payroll support: maintain salary bands, benchmark pay against the market, administer benefits, and give Finance accurate payroll inputs each cycle. Training, engagement, and reporting: coordinate onboarding training and skills development, run an annual engagement survey, and report monthly on headcount, hiring, and turnover. What you bring Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field. SHRM-CP, PHR, or equivalent preferred. 8+ years in HR, including 3+ years in a leadership role. Experience running full cycle recruitment, onboarding, and offboarding, including background checks. Experience designing performance management and appraisal processes. Experience selecting and implementing HR tools, such as leave management systems. Experience with multi country workforces and contractor arrangements, ideally across the US and Latin America. Strong knowledge of employment law and HR best practices. Strong written and verbal English. Spanish is a plus. Comfortable working in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel, SharePoint). The details Full time, fully remote. You must be located in Pakistan. Reports directly to the CEO. Working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, which is 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM in Pakistan. If you have built HR for a multi country team and want real ownership of the function, we want to hear from you.
